source.title: Cleansing Water
source.description: Faded and soggy notes are wrapped around a murky bottle. Sapta. You can't recall it ever looking like this, but it seems similar enough. It smells odd, as if tainted somehow. A Spirit Rock must be nearby, though it would be long-abandoned. Finding it might be the missing piece to this strange puzzle.
source.objective:
Find the tainted Spirit Rock and drink the Murky Water Sapta.

Provided item:
source.completion:
You cleansed. You restored. Strong spirit. You help.

Corruption still lives. Stop it.
